scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: St. Olaf College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (section PDFs A-J, Institutional Effectiveness and Assessment)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class from the Common Data Set: 7,310 applied (3,386 men, 3,779 women, 145 unknown sex), 3,171 admitted, 794 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state Minnesota 1,861 / out-of-state 2,877 / international 2,569 / unknown 3 applicants; 1,199 / 1,496 / 476 / 0 admitted; 338 / 362 / 94 / 0 enrolled) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 2,569 applied, 476 admitted, 94 enrolled (B2 lists 95 nonresident first-year students). Waitlist: 1,696 offered, 472 accepted, 23 admitted. The ED figures (504 applications, 277 admits, 'Fall 2025 entering class') do not say whether they cover Early Decision 1 only or both rounds; no early action counts are given. SAT/ACT scores are optional: 13% (101 students) of enrolled first-years submitted SAT and 30% (238) ACT. The CDS prints whole percentages only; the GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (0% for 2.0-2.49, 1.0-1.99 and below 1.0), the average GPA of 3.75 is reported by 88% of first-years. Undergraduate enrollment (3,114) and the nonresident count (336) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures in B1/B2.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for the 2026-27 academic year from the Common Data Set (G1): tuition $65,700, required fees $500, on-campus food and housing $15,000 (housing $7,150 + food $7,850), a comprehensive fee of $81,200. Estimated expenses (G5, residents): books and supplies $1,000, transportation $600, other expenses $0 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Per-credit-hour charge $2,190. St. Olaf's international aid page adds that all international students are enrolled in the college's group health insurance plan, about $500 per semester ($1,000 for the year), billed separately. The CDS (H6) says institutional need-based and non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents but leaves the number of aided nonresidents and the average award blank.
